trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 3 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not calibrated."; ", not a fit:" — state the positive claim directly

Density is high, but this proposition's subject IS the partition of a formula's factors into literature / measured / derived, so each contrast separates two provenance classes the block has to keep apart. trap-em-dash.evidence: 18 stylistic spaced dashes in 1372 words (1.31/100w) — restructure into sentences
